# Bismillah Pakhi & Aquarium (বিসমিল্লাহ পাখি এন্ড অ্যাকোয়ারিয়াম)

> Chuadanga's premier destination for exotic pet birds, ornamental aquarium fishes, planted tank supplies, and authentic pet nutrition in Bangladesh. Located at Boro Bazar, Chuadanga. Phone/WhatsApp: +8801947315330.

Bismillah Pakhi & Aquarium (owned by Arfin) provides healthy, hand-selected pet birds (Budgerigar, Cockatiel, Lovebird, Sun Conure, Macaw), aquarium fishes (Goldfish, Betta, Guppy, Koi Carp, Arowana), dust-free seed mixes, ZuPreem pellets, and planted aquarium accessories across Chuadanga, Khulna Division, and Bangladesh.

## Core Store Pages
- [Homepage - Bismillah Pakhi & Aquarium](https://bismillahpakhiandaquarium.vercel.app/): Main showcase of featured birds, aquarium fishes, rare exotic pre-bookings, and customer reviews.
- [All Pets & Products Collection](https://bismillahpakhiandaquarium.vercel.app/collection): Complete catalog of available birds, fishes, pet foods, and aquarium accessories.
- [Pet Compatibility Quiz](https://bismillahpakhiandaquarium.vercel.app/match): Interactive quiz to help customers find the ideal bird or aquarium fish for their home.
- [Pet Care Blog & Guides](https://bismillahpakhiandaquarium.vercel.app/blog): Expert Bengali and English articles on bird breeding, winter care, and aquarium setup.
- [Contact & Pre-Booking](https://bismillahpakhiandaquarium.vercel.app/contact): Store location in Boro Bazar, Chuadanga, opening hours, and direct WhatsApp consultation.

## Product Categories
- [Pet Birds Category](https://bismillahpakhiandaquarium.vercel.app/categories/birds): Budgies, Cockatiels, Lovebirds, Finches, Conures, and Macaws.
- [Aquarium & Fishes Category](https://bismillahpakhiandaquarium.vercel.app/categories/aquarium): Ornamental fishes, planted tanks, and aquatic life.
- [Pet Food & Nutrition](https://bismillahpakhiandaquarium.vercel.app/categories/food): Premium seed mixes, pellets, and fish food.
- [Cages & Aquarium Accessories](https://bismillahpakhiandaquarium.vercel.app/categories/accessories): Filters, air pumps, LED lighting, aqua soil, and bird cages.
